cases.label: unknown-field
cases.note: a top-level field add doesn't have, with a value that isn't null: unknown_field

cases.label: null-field
cases.note: the same field as null: the signed-object parse refuses a null anywhere before the action's fields are read: malformed

cases.label: expired-body-still-needs-chain-validation
cases.note: a service add whose expires_at is before its signed_at: the shape is accepted; required_version checks no chain or clock

cases.label: input-over-16-kib
cases.note: 16,385 spaces before E5's body, 17,020 bytes: over the strict reader's 16 KiB input bound, read as not strict JSON: malformed

cases.label: body-of-4096-bytes
cases.note: E5 with ops launch and view, 44 project hashes and a longer device id: exactly 4,096 bytes of JCS, the body bound

cases.label: body-of-4097-bytes
cases.note: the same with one byte more of device id: over the body bound (within the 16 KiB input bound): too_large

name: r9-vectors-required-verifier
note: Unsigned membership-entry bodies (body_json, the exact text passed) and what the shared core's membership::required_version gives each (session-v1 R9.2 "How the signing gate uses it"): requirement null (an entry every release from v0.8.0 to v0.8.5 accepts), {action, minimum_version} (the first verifier version that accepts it), or reject: true with reason, the Invalid code a verifier gives that shape (bindings: Membership{code: membership_invalid, detail: reason}). A label starting with a capital letter is that entry of r9-vectors-membership-log (its jcs); the others are E5 (svc-discord's service add) changed as the label says: add-<ops> and set_roles-<ops> with those scope ops (set_roles-*: the same member as a set_roles), the rest as the case's note says. Only each body's shape is checked: no signature, chain, membership authority or participant authentication is established.
